scripts.shopify:app:dev: npm run shopify:preflight && npm run shopify:config:render && bash ./deploy/shopify/run-shopify-cli.sh app dev --path .
scripts.shopify:app:info: npm run shopify:preflight && npm run shopify:config:render && bash ./deploy/shopify/run-shopify-cli.sh app info --path .
scripts.shopify:app:deploy: npm run shopify:preflight && npm run shopify:config:render && bash ./deploy/shopify/run-shopify-cli.sh app deploy --allow-updates --path .
scripts.shopify:app:release: npm run shopify:preflight && npm run shopify:config:render && bash ./deploy/shopify/run-shopify-cli.sh app release --path .
